description:
As a compliance officer, I want idle sessions to end so that an unattended screen does not expose client data.
Acceptance criteria:
- Given I am signed in, when I am idle for 15 minutes, then I am signed out and see the login page
- Given I was signed out by timeout, then the login page says "You were signed out after 15 minutes of inactivity."
- Given I am active, when I click anywhere, then the idle timer restarts
